result.instructions: This server puts an agent's model routing behind a Flagsmith experiment. For each task: call get_routing_policy once with a stable identity for that task, run the task with the models and caps in the policy it returns, then call report_outcome once with the same identity. Flagsmith chooses the arm. Never pick a model yourself when get_routing_policy fails: report the error. Pass fallback_policy only if the user has decided what to run when Flagsmith is unavailable. get_kill_switch, price_usage and explain_assignment send nothing to the experiment. explain_assignment and price_usage work with no Flagsmith key.

tools.name: get_routing_policy
tools.title: Get the routing policy for a task
tools.description: Ask Flagsmith which routing policy one task runs: the model for each lane, the caps and the prompt variant. Call it once per task, before the first model call. Flagsmith buckets the identity into an arm and, when the identity is enrolled in a running experiment, the exposure is recorded and sent at once. The server never picks an arm: if the kill switch or the flag cannot be read, or the flag's value is not a valid policy, the result is an error carrying Flagsmith's own message, unless you passed fallback_policy. Calling it again for the same identity in one session returns the first answer without asking Flagsmith again.

identity.description: The Flagsmith identity of one task, for example "task:1234". Use one identity per task and the same one in every call about that task: Flagsmith joins the exposure and the outcome on it.

traits.description: Traits of the task (for example repo, language) sent to Flagsmith with the identity, for segment rules and breakdowns. Values are strings, numbers, booleans or null.

fallback_policy.description: Optional. A complete routing policy (your control policy; format in the forkbill://routing-policy resource) to run when Flagsmith cannot serve a valid one. Leave it out and a Flagsmith failure is returned as an error. Pass it and the result uses this policy for the kill switch, an unreadable flag or an invalid flag value, and says so in `source` and `fail_reason`.

variant.description: The variant key Flagsmith bucketed the identity into, when it reported one.

source.description: experiment: enrolled in a running experiment, exposure recorded. flag: the flag's value, no experiment. kill_switch: the kill switch is on. fail_closed: the fallback_policy you passed.

exposure_recorded.description: True when the exposure event was accepted by Flagsmith's events API.

policy.description: The policy's label, usually the variant key.

model.description: Model for the main lane: planning and decisions.
Model for the delegate lane: searches, long reads, test runs.

turns.description: Stop after this many main-lane turns.

usd_per_task.description: Stop once the task has spent this many US dollars.

reused.description: True when this identity was already assigned in this session and Flagsmith was not asked again.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.title: Report how a task ended
tools.description: Send a finished task's outcome to Flagsmith as the experiment's metric events: task_cost (US dollars), task_turns and task_seconds for every task, and task_solved only when solved is true. Call it once per task, with the identity used in get_routing_policy, for unsolved and capped tasks as well. Events go out only for an identity whose exposure was recorded; for any other identity nothing is sent and the result says why. The result lists the events Flagsmith accepted, and it is an error if any was not accepted.

identity.description: The Flagsmith identity of one task, for example "task:1234". Use one identity per task and the same one in every call about that task: Flagsmith joins the exposure and the outcome on it.

cost_usd.description: Total model spend on the task in US dollars. Report it for every task, solved or not.

solved.description: Whether the task met its success test. task_solved is sent only when true.

turns.description: Number of agent turns the task took.

seconds.description: Seconds from getting the policy to the end of the task.

exposure_recorded_elsewhere.description: Set true only when this identity's exposure was recorded by another process or an earlier session of this server, so the server cannot see it. Events for an identity with no exposure are ignored by Flagsmith's results.

events.description: The events Flagsmith accepted, in order.

tools.name: get_kill_switch
tools.title: Read the kill switch
tools.description: Read the kill switch flag (routing_kill unless FORKBILL_KILL_FLAG names another) at environment level. When it is on, get_routing_policy returns the control policy, records no exposure and report_outcome sends nothing, so tasks run but stay out of the experiment's data. This call reads one flag and sends no exposure or event. get_routing_policy checks the switch itself for each identity, so this is for status, not a step you must take.

configured.description: False when the kill switch is turned off with FORKBILL_KILL_FLAG=none.

exists.description: False when the environment has no flag of that name.

tools.name: explain_assignment
tools.title: Re-derive an assignment offline
tools.description: Work out, with no network call, which variant an identity gets from a saved Flagsmith environment document, and show every step: the hashing key, the md5 of each segment check, the feature state chosen, the md5 of the split and the range it lands in. The same document is also evaluated with Flagsmith's own engine and the two answers are compared. Use it to check that a task ran the arm it was dealt, or to see why an identity landed where it did. Needs no Flagsmith key and sends nothing. The md5 recomputation covers percentage-split segments, which is what an experiment rollout uses; for other segment rules the working is null and the engine's answer is reported.

identity.description: The Flagsmith identity of one task, for example "task:1234". Use one identity per task and the same one in every call about that task: Flagsmith joins the exposure and the outcome on it.

environment_document.description: The Flagsmith environment document, as a JSON object or a JSON string (what `flagsmith environment document` prints). Give this or environment_document_path, not both.

environment_document_path.description: Path of a saved environment document on the machine the server runs on.

flag.description: Flag to explain. Defaults to the server's routing flag.

traits.description: Traits the identity had. Only needed when a segment rule reads a trait; the engine check uses them.

expected_variant.description: The variant the task actually ran, to check against the re-derived one.

variant.description: The re-derived variant key. Null for a flag with no variants.

policy.description: The policy's label, usually the variant key.

model.description: Model for the main lane: planning and decisions.
Model for the delegate lane: searches, long reads, test runs.

turns.description: Stop after this many main-lane turns.

usd_per_task.description: Stop once the task has spent this many US dollars.

policy.description: The policy that variant serves, when the value is a valid routing policy.

input.description: The string that was hashed, with the environment key shown as <api_key>.
The string that was hashed, with the environment key shown as <api_key>.

working.description: Every step of the md5 recomputation. Null when the document needs rules it does not cover.

agree.description: Whether the md5 recomputation and Flagsmith's engine give the same variant.

session_variant.description: The variant get_routing_policy got for this identity in this session, if any.

tools.name: price_usage
tools.title: Price token usage
tools.description: Turn token counts into US dollars with the server's pricing table (the forkbill://pricing resource). Pass one entry per model call, or one per lane with the task's totals. Each entry needs a model, or a lane together with the identity of a task that got its policy in this session, in which case the lane's model comes from that policy and the total is checked against the policy's dollar cap. Nothing is sent to Flagsmith; use the total as cost_usd in report_outcome. Rates are flat per token: a higher tier a provider charges for long prompts is not applied.

lane.description: The lane the call ran on. With `identity`, the lane also picks the model.

model.description: Model id as it appears in the pricing table. Overrides the lane's model.

calls.description: One entry per model call, or one per lane with the task's token totals.

identity.description: A task that got its policy from get_routing_policy in this session. Calls that name only a lane are priced with that policy's models, and the total is checked against its dollar cap.

total_usd.description: US dollars, rounded to 6 places as task_cost is.

over_budget.description: True once total_usd reaches the policy's usd_per_task cap.

content.text:
agent_routing for identity ex04:task-0001
1. Hashing key: <api_key>_ex04:task-0001 (the environment key, an underscore, the identity).
2. Segment experiment-2-rollout (2): md5("2,<api_key>_ex04:task-0001") = 8d7466115713ff3de53e907e7a3c7467; as an integer mod 9999 = 7919; 7919 / 9998 x 100 = 79.2058; <= 100, inside the segment.
3. Feature state used: the override from segment experiment-2-rollout, id 6, enabled, experiment 2 "examples (simulated traffic, not study data)", in_experiment true.
4. Split: md5("6,<api_key>_ex04:task-0001") = 53e507d6f892fcd30e7cdc00740997b5; as an integer mod 9999 = 6969; 6969 / 9998 x 100 = 69.7039.
5. Ranges in variant id order: lanes_v1 [0, 50), control [50, 100). 69.7039 falls in control.
Variant: control.
Flagsmith's engine: variant control (TARGETING_MATCH; segment=experiment-2-rollout). The two agree.
This session was served control for the identity: matches.
